blocks.html: In September of 2017, the ISO (International Organization for Standardization) approved a new version of C++, called C++17. C++17 contains a fair amount of new content
blocks.preview: In September of 2017, the ISO (International Organization for Standardization) a
blocks.html_cs: V září 2017 schválila ISO (International Organization for Standardization) novou verzi C++ s názvem C++17. C++17 obsahuje značné množství nového obsahu

blocks.html: For your interest, here’s a list of the major changes that C++17 adds. Note that this list is not comprehensive, but rather intended to highlight some of the key changes of interest.
blocks.preview: For your interest, here’s a list of the major changes that C++17 adds. Note that
blocks.html_cs: Pro zajímavost zde je seznam hlavních změn, které C++17 přidává. Všimněte si, že tento seznam není úplný, ale má spíše zdůraznit některé klíčové změny, které vás zajímají.

blocks.html:
• Class template argument deduction (CTAD) (13.14 -- Class template argument deduction (CTAD) and deduction guides)
  • if statements that resolve at compile time (8.4 -- Constexpr if statements)
  • Initializers in if statements and switch statements (mentioned in 13.y -- Using a language reference)
  • inline variables (7.10 -- Sharing global constants across multiple files (using inline variables))
  • Fold expressions (no tutorial yet)
  • Mandatory copy elision for some cases (mentioned in 14.15 -- Class initialization and copy elision)
  • Nested namespaces can now be defined as namespace X::Y (7.2 -- User-defined namespaces and the scope resolution operator)
  • Removal of std::auto_ptr and some other deprecated types
  • static_assert no longer requires a diagnostic text message parameter (9.6 -- Assert and static_assert)
  • std::any (no tutorial yet)
  • std::byte (no tutorial yet)
  • std::filesystem (no tutorial yet)
  • std::optional (12.15 -- std::optional)
  • std::shared_ptr can now manage C-style arrays (but std::make_shared can’t create them yet) (22.6 -- std::shared_ptr)
  • std::size (11.2 -- Arrays (Part II))
  • std::string_view (5.8 -- Introduction to std::string_view)
  • Structured binding declarations (no tutorial yet)
  • Trigraphs have been removed
  • typename can now be used (instead of class) in a template template parameter
  • UTF-8 (u8) character literals (no tutorial yet)
